summary: Jefferies Financial Group Inc. filed a preliminary pricing supplement under Rule 424(b)(5) for a new issuance of Senior Autocallable Contingent Coupon Barrier Notes due 2032, linked to the worst-performing of the VanEck Semiconductor ETF and the S&P 500 Index. The notes are unsecured, with a $1,000 stated principal amount per note, and offer contingent quarterly coupon payments and an automatic call feature beginning six months after pricing. This is a routine debt securities offering, not a special situation. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change.
